---
title: "Master of Science Alumni"
page-layout: full
css: styles.css
format:
  html:
    include-after-body:
      - category-accordion-script.html
      - alumni-toggle-script.html
      - alumni-filter-script.html
listing:
  - id: alumni-filter
    contents: "profiles/ms-alumni/**/*.qmd"
    type: grid
    page-size: 9999
    grid-columns: 5
    fields: [image, title, subtitle, description]
    categories: unnumbered
  - id: ms2026
    contents: "profiles/ms-alumni/ms2026/*.qmd"
    type: grid
    page-size: 9999
    grid-columns: 5
    sort-ui: [title, description]
    sort: false
    filter-ui: [title, subtitle, description]
    fields: [image, title, subtitle, description]
  - id: ms2025
    contents: "profiles/ms-alumni/ms2025/*.qmd"
    type: grid
    page-size: 9999
    grid-columns: 5
    sort-ui: [title, description]
    sort: false
    filter-ui: [title, subtitle, description]
    fields: [image, title, subtitle, description]
  - id: alumni-table
    contents: "profiles/ms-alumni/**/*.qmd"
    type: table
    sort-ui: [title, description, graduation, advisor]
    filter-ui: [title, description, graduation, advisor]
    fields: [title, description, graduation, advisor]
    field-display-names:
      title: "Name"
      description: "Cohort"
      graduation: "Graduation Year"
      advisor: "Advisor"
    table-hover: true
---

```{=html}
<p class="mb-4" style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:1rem;">
  <a href="directory.html" class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm">
    &larr; Back to Directory
  </a>
  <span style="margin-left:auto;">
    <button id="btn-grid" class="btn btn-sm btn-secondary" onclick="setAlumniView('grid')">⊞ Grid</button>
    <button id="btn-table" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" onclick="setAlumniView('table')">☰ List</button>
  </span>
</p>
```

:::{#alumni-filter}
:::
